title.narrative: NPI Community Partnerships for Respectful Care (CPRC)

description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): .This project is under the GH NPI APS, Round 1, Community Health Networks. This project will be focussed on Liberia and Tanzania and will build on USAID support in the RMNCH sector, building upon past gains, align with ongoing programs, and address remaining gaps specific to respectful health care, all while working through underutilized partners whose potential to influence societal norms related to RMC that may have yet to be harnessed. This project will address both the supply and demand side of maternal health care service delivery through a community-level health intervention model. Americares and their partners will support those providing skilled care, aiming to improve the quality of care and increase the number of women delivering with a skilled birth attendant, as well as accessing other essential services such as family planning, newborn and child health services and nutrition outreach. They will work with civil society, religious partners and other community groups, as well as government authorities at the relevant region/ county and district levels, to understand and address the barriers to seeking care from the client perspective. In support of each country's Journey to Self-Reliance, the project will also improve capacity of local partners. This project includes the participation of three faith-based health networks: the U.S. -based Christian Connections for International Health (CCIH), the Liberia-based Christian Health Association of Liberia (CHAL), and the Tanzania-based Christian Social Services Commission..
